Upper Text: [Main] Reveal the top 3 cards of your deck. Add 1 card with [Davis Motomiya] in its name and 1 card with the [Free] trait among them to the hand. Trash the rest. Then, place this card in the battle area.
[All Turns] When the top stacked card of any your [Armor Form] trait Digimon is trashed, ＜Delay＞.
・1 of your Digimon may digivolve into a Digimon card with the [Armor Form] trait in the hand without paying the cost.
